note: Civilian subset of the corrected legacy22-joint rig: idle, walk and fall/recovery, plus a run and a sprint for fleeing and Snow's jump and climb poses under their snow-jump-poses.json names (normalized one-second clips, see civilian-flee.motion.json); no weapons or vehicle actions. All existing NPC geometry/skin/socket/scale budgets retained.

skeleton.optionalExtraJoints: finger and face joints may be kept if the total stays under maxJoints; they must not be required by any clip

sockets.purpose: pistol grip: +Z barrel direction, +Y up, origin at the grip centre
name tag / headshot sphere centre (0.1 m above eye level)

clips.name: walk
clips.note: one full stride cycle (two steps); feet planted without skating against a 1.4 m/s forward trajectory

clips.name: run
clips.note: fleeing run: one cycle from the left-foot strike, feet locked against a 3.6 m/s trajectory

clips.name: sprint
clips.note: fleeing sprint from a nearby shot: one cycle from the left-foot strike, feet locked against a 5 m/s trajectory

clips.name: death
clips.note: collapse to the ground, last frame held; no gore

materials: baked base colour only (metallic 0, roughness 0.8); no transparency except hair cards; no vertex colours required

prop.note: Original low-poly pistol (under 600 triangles, one material, dark grey): origin at the grip centre, barrel along +Z, length 0.19 m, so it drops straight onto SOCKET_HAND_R
